items.problem: For store `GOOGLE`, the restore of a new login session joins a `restore_purchases` still running from the previous session, and line 546 has already set `_google_restored` to `true`. The joined result is discarded and `list_owned` does not run again in that session, although `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/payment-core.md:146` has one restore per login session. Reproduced with a test in a temporary copy: first `recover_purchases` of session A, its restore held on `RecoverPurchase`, `log_in` of another user, `recover_purchases` in the new session, the held response released, then `recover_purchases` again. `list_owned` stayed at 1 call and `_google_restored` was `true`. The same join makes a `restore_purchases` that content code calls in the new session wait for the old session's run; that path was read in the code and not run. This existed before the range.

A `recover_purchases` called in a new login session joins a run still going from the previous session and gets that run's discarded result, so the new session's recovery (`BootstrapCore` at `AfterLogin`) handles no transaction. `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/payment-core.md:144` makes the call share the run in progress, and `:160` ends that run with the failure value, so a store transaction stays undelivered until the next recovery time (a foreground return or a delivery retry). This is a different operation from D9 of the debt list, which covers the same join for `restore_purchases`. Reproduced with a test in a temporary copy, store `APPLE`: `fake_add_unfinished` of `[iap_gems]`, `add_pending(core/RecoverPurchase)`, `recover_purchases`, `log_in` of another user, `recover_purchases` again, then the held response released with `GRANTED`. Both calls returned `false`, `list_unfinished` stayed at 1 call, `RecoverPurchase` at 1 request and `finish` at 0 calls. `test_verification_response_of_an_earlier_login_session_changes_nothing` in `tests/test_recovery.gd` shows that a later `recover_purchases` handles the transaction. This existed before the range. The fix may need a decision on the spec, because the two lines together define this result
